name: @imhonglu/json-schema-conformance
description: Private JSON Schema conformance test generator and runner.

scripts.generate-tests: pnpm run build && node ./dist/bin/generate-tests.cli.js && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run check:baseline
scripts.refresh-tests: pnpm run sync-suite && pnpm run generate-tests
scripts.pretest:conformance: pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run check:baseline
